transcript.text: If you risk $2 to make only a dollar,
you'd have to be right 67% of the time
to break even. Which means if I had this
inverted or negative profit to loss
ratio over the past 46 days, I really
wouldn't have produced much profit. On
the other hand, if I could have been
risking a dollar to make $2, well, I
would have been able to make twice as
much money over the same period of time.
And so I always look at a trade and I
ask myself if I have the potential to at
least make what I'm risking, if not
